title: Close-range B-B pair at separation 1.0, at rest: attractive K/r^2.5 with K = 3.86 (T <= 0.3)

claims.statement: Two B particles at rest, initial separation 1.000 (within 0.001), duration at most 0.3: each accelerates toward the other with magnitude K / r^2.5 (r the current separation, P = 2.5 fixed) and K = 3.86 (chamber and time units; attractive). K is the pooled per-run fit of four lab-a runs (two horizontal, two diagonal at the same centre), each with P fixed. The horizontal and diagonal means agree within 1.5%. The run-to-run spread is 0.03 (sd). This K is about 3% below the K = 3.98 of P-0017 (lab-b); the judged metric cannot separate the two at this duration.
